title: Institutions Drive Bitcoin Surge
script_summary:
**INSTITUTIONS ARE MOVING BITCOIN INTO CORE HOLDINGS.**

The $39 trillion US debt crisis isn't theoretical anymore—it's forcing institutional capital away from fiat. Paulson's emergency plan signals what we already know: the dollar's reserve status is cracking.

Here's what's happening on-chain. Bitcoin hit 77,000 on heavyweight buying pressure. Hashrate climbed to 960 EH/s—deep-pocket miners aren't speculating, they're accumulating. Market dominance at 57.3% shows corporate flows are tightening
